protocol.only_condition_differences: edge-derived K source plus matched phase source control
protocol.coupling_equation: theta_i[t] = theta_i[t-1] + source_delta_i[t] + g * sum_j K[i,j] * sin(theta_j[t-1] - theta_i[t-1])
protocol.normalization: each post-leg row divided by its own absolute signed raw K row sum; fixed anatomy-only input scaling
protocol.engine: continuous_phase.run_engine / StepGaitEngine.continuous_targets; fixed Path-1 waveform

coupling.edge_source: audit_intersegmental.cross_edges official T1/T2/T3 edges at absolute synapse floor 5
coupling.sign_source: fetch_manc.nt_signs predicted_nt: acetylcholine +1; GABA/glutamate -1; unknown omitted
coupling.row_normalization: each post-leg row divided by its own absolute signed raw K row sum; fixed anatomy-only input scaling
coupling.shuffled_rule: permute signed nonzero raw K entries across the fixed real nonzero mask
coupling.random_rule: independently permute raw magnitudes and signs across the fixed real nonzero mask

criterion.basis: clean ideal alternating-tripod clock only; no body outcome or condition performance used

protocol.phase_definition: analytic phase of band-passed mean flexor-minus-extensor antagonist activity
analytic phase of band-passed mean flexor-minus-extensor antagonist activity
independent linear phases with real-source per-leg mean frequencies and seeded uniform initial phases

pre_registered_null: real-edge coupling will not outperform shuffled or random K on tripod coherence, feet planted, or path; coordination will not transfer

continuous_phase.definition: circular phase coherence of continuous per-leg engine phase; canonical tripod groups used only for reporting
